representation_authority: NONE; this packet defines causal/content topology only and must not imply art direction.
name: Reoriented Exposure Field
topology_law: An earlier human reorientation of a broad existing cover/reflector/exposure-control element persistently changes a large environmental exposure pattern within one connected shared space. Two distinct people now occupy/use overlapping space under materially different exposure conditions caused by that orientation.
prior_action: A broad exposure-modifying element was rotated or reoriented around a physically legible support/pivot and remains in the changed orientation.
present_relation: Differential exposure/visibility/comfort within one shared connected space; neither person is separated by a barrier.
recoverable_evidence: The current element orientation, its support/pivot relation and the large cast/exposure pattern make the changed orientation and a simpler alternate orientation recoverable without text or arrows.
restoration_counterfactual: Returning the element toward its prior orientation would materially change the exposure pattern affecting both people and alter their present spatial use.

axes.causal carrier locus: projected environmental exposure pattern from an oriented broad element
axes.spatial relation topology: overlapping projected zones in one unpartitioned space
axes.recoverable evidence type: orientation/pivot relation plus large coherent cast/exposure pattern
axes.restoration counterfactual: restore orientation -> exposure zones materially change

specific_prohibitions: no wall/fence/barrier as the causal carrier
no unit-built surface or mosaic field
no sequential small objects or path
